verses.text: Ol yal Israel icha tik: ¿Tok ay mach tz'ak'anoch t'a sk'ol tas skaleli? ¿Tok ay mach snachajel yuj to a spoder Jehová scheklaj t'a jun ab'ix tik? xcham heb'.
Snib'ej Jehová to a jun schekab' chi' sk'ib' icha swol junok te te' tz'em sch'anhal yib' t'a takinh lu'um. Manh nib'ab'ilok yilji, malaj tas wach' skiloch t'ay.

Ha heb' anima, ol sb'uch jun chekab' chi' heb', ol spatikejel heb'. Ol ak'jokoch ya'elal t'a yib'anh yuj heb', ol techaj yuj, yujto k'ajan yab'an sya'il. Icha junok mach manhxo smojok yiljiochi, ol patikajelok. Malaj ol elk'och jun chekab' chi' t'ayonh.
Ha ko na'ani to ha Dios tz'ak'anoch ya'elal t'a yib'anh, syak'anpaxkan t'a emnakilal, palta manh ichokta'. Ha ko ya'elal a onh tik ol ak'jokoch t'a yib'anh, ol yab' sya'il ko k'exulok.
Ol tekjokek' k'e'en t'a sniwanil yuj ko pitalil, ol yab'an wal sya'il yuj ko chukal. Yuj sya'elal ol yab' chi', ol ochxi junk'olal t'a ko kal yet' Dios. Yuj yechnaj chi', ol yak'xi ko k 'inal.
Ko masanil ix onh saklemkanb'at icha nok' kalnel. Junjun onh ix ko na' tas b'eal b'aj ix ko nib'ej b'aj ix onh b'atkani, haxo Jehová ol ak'ankanoch ko mul ko masanil t'a yib'anh jun schekab' chi'.

Ol ak'jok wal och sya'elal yuj heb' anima, emnakilal ol aj yuj heb', palta malaj tas ol yala'. Ol ik'jokb'at yuj heb', icha tz'aj yik'jib'at nok' kalnel b'aj smiljichamok. Malaj tas ol yala', numannhej ol ajok, icha nok' kalnel sjoxchaji.

Ol ik'chajelta t'a preso yik sch'olb'itaji, ol ak'jokoch chamel t'a yib'anh. Malaj mach ol och ilk'olal yuj schamel chi'. Ol ik'chajel t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik yuj ko mul a onh schonhab' onh tik. Ku'uj ol yab' sya'il.
Malaj wal jab'ok chukal ol sk'ulej, malaj jab'ok es ol elta t'a sti'. Wach'chom icha chi', a sna'an heb' anima to ol mukchaj t'a skal heb' chuk, palta haxo t'a skal heb' b'eyum ol mukchajok.

Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ol wak' yab' sya'il in chekab' icha yaj in na'ani. Ol yak'och sb'a silab'il t'a yol sk'ab' chamel yik tz'ak'jikan lajwok smul masanil anima. Yuj chi' ol pitzwokkan t'a junelnhej, ol yil heb' yinhtilal. Yuj, ol elkank'och tas nab'il wu'uj.

Ayik toxo ix lajwiek' juntzanh ya'elal chi' t'a yib'anh, ol tzalaj yuj spak jun ya'elal chi' to manh nab'anhejok ix yab' sya'il. Tzijtum heb' anima ol ochkan wach'il yuj yojtakanel in chekab' chi' heb', yujto ol ik'jokkanel smul heb' yuj.

Yuj chi' ol wak' yopisio t'a skal heb' niwak yelk'ochi. Ay yalan yik yet' heb' yak'an ganar owal, yujto ix yak'och sb'a t'a yol sk'ab' chamel. Icha wal tz'utaj heb' sk'ulan chukal, icha chi' ix utaji. Ix sb'ek sb'a yuj smul masanil anima, ix tewi yuj heb' yik tz'ak'jikan lajwok smul heb' chi', xchi Jehová.
